G1_unambiguity.justification: The rules clearly define that no selected pair may share an interaction event, so the valid panel is unambiguous.

G2_completeness.justification: The statement provides the necessary constraints, input format, output format, validity conditions, and edge-case bounds.

G3_faithfulness.justification: The sequential incompatibility process is exactly equivalent to selecting an independent set of exactly k users, with unchanged bounds and output requirements.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is clear and idiomatic, though the sequential flagging mechanism is a somewhat contrived restatement of the simpler no-friendship condition.
